messages:
Priya Singh: Random ask-the-room: If your houseplant could give you one piece of unsolicited life advice, what would it say? :seedling:
Dave Kim: 'Stop checking the soil every hour.' 100% would be mine. :joy:
Emma Johnson: Mine would be 'less screen time, more sunlight' which is fair and rude. :sun_with_face:
Carlos M.: My ficus would lecture me about commitment. 'Water me on schedule or don't expect leaves.' :pensive:
Kai (intern): My succulents would be low-key savage: 'Stop overcomplicating things. Also, buy better soil.' :sweat_smile:
Priya Singh: Bonus: what would your plant nickname itself if it could choose? mine: 'Chonk McPhotosynthesis'
Dave Kim: 'Judgey McLeaf' for sure.
Emma Johnson: 'Professor Chlorophyll' lol
poll-bot: Poll created: "Which plant advice resonates most?" Options: Stop overwatering / Get more sun / Commit to care / Buy better soil / Less screen time 14 vote with emoji reactions.
Carlos M.: Also, confession: i talk to my plants when i'm stressed. sometimes i think they answer back. :thinking_face:
Priya Singh: same. plant conversations are free therapy.
Kai (intern): Vote placed (Buy better soil).
Emma Johnson: Vote placed (Get more sun).
Dave Kim: Vote placed (Stop overwatering).
Priya Singh: Results update: Stop overwatering x2, Get more sun x3, Commit to care x1, Buy better soil x2, Less screen time x1 — close race but sunlight is winning.
poll-bot: Poll closed automatically 14 winner: Get more sun.
Priya Singh: New office challenge: bring a tiny plant prop for our next all-hands and nickname it. stakes: bragging rights + a sticker. :seedling: 
Carlos M.: i'm in. i will bring 'Judgey McLeaf' and a tiny beret.
Dave Kim: I'll bring cute watering can prop.
Emma Johnson: Sticker demands noted. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Kai (intern): I'll make a quick google sheet for signups.
